Thanks Sam — helpful context. A couple of quick items before the Sep 8 follow-up so we can make that session productive:

1) API key scope: The 403 + \"Invalid API key\" string usually means the key was mistyped or the key being used belongs to a different org. Please confirm the first 8 characters of the key (in the Console) and redact the rest when pasting.
2) SDK vs curl: can you confirm whether you were using the Node SDK (v1.3.0+) or a straight curl request? Older SDK releases had a header mismatch bug we addressed in v1.3.0.
3) Local proxy: if your corporate proxy does TLS inspection and substitutes certs we sometimes see validation fail. A quick way to check: from the same workstation run curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/ping and paste the TLS issuer.

I've attached the Redwood troubleshooting guide (redwood-troubleshooting-guide.pdf) and a small session-log template (session-log-0901.txt) — please fill the template with the request/response you saw and paste into this thread. If you can confirm Sep 8 10:30 PT, I'll send a calendar invite and provision a fresh short-lived API key for the session so we can rule out key rotation issues.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
